links.outcome: LLM accuracy under permuted answer-option order in TCM benchmark questions
links.effect: All 15 evaluated models, including top scorers, showed substantial performance degradation when option ordering was varied, indicating positional bias and fragile inference. No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: All evaluated models, including the highest-scoring ones, displayed a substantial performance degradation when faced with varied question option ordering, indicating a pervasive sensitivity to positional bias and a lack of robust understanding.

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates LLMs on a comprehensive benchmark (TCM-5CEval) for Traditional Chinese Medicine clinical competence, testing reasoning stability and bias, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
